title: Diamond State (active.yml)
description: The framework's most-read state file: active/parked/archived/killed diamonds per engine/diamond-rules.md § Diamond State Tracking. Permissive by design (additionalProperties: true) — projects extend freely; the schema pins the load-bearing core: ids, scale/phase enums, confidence range, and the definition_of_done shape (v0.43.0). Added 2026-06-12 after the dogfood repo's active.yml sat committed-unparseable for ≥3 days with zero detection (corrections.md 2026-06-12).

autonomous.description: Declared autonomous run (engine/autonomous-mode.md). One of the three declaration surfaces the autonomous-evidence-guard reads.

_meta.description: File-level metadata. `last_validated` is the date a human last confirmed the content accurate; staleness horizon per engine/evidence-decay.md (strategic, 180 days). Replaced top-level `last_updated` in v0.89.0 — that field duplicated what git already records authoritatively, and a hand-maintained copy of a machine-knowable fact can only drift.

completed_diamonds.description: Diamonds whose Definition of Done was MET, with evidence. Distinct from archived_diamonds, which is where work goes when it STOPS. Added v0.230.0: check_scale_occupancy.py had read this key since it shipped, while no schema defined it and no skill wrote it, so 'ever opened' could never count a finished cycle and compliance with completion was unverifiable. Written by /diamond-progress; see its Step 9b.

archived_diamonds.description: Work that STOPPED and is no longer tracked, without its DoD being met. NOT a synonym for completed - that conflation is why completion was uncheckable before v0.230.0.

confidence.description: REQUIRED as of v0.92.0. Gates depend on it — diamond-rules.md spawns L3 to L4 only when 'solutions pass confidence threshold', and twelve skills read this field. A field a spawn gate consults cannot be optional at the point the gate reads it. An ABSENT value is not low confidence, it is no position, and consumers were defaulting it (0.5 in one evaluator) which made 'never recorded' indistinguishable from 'recorded too high'. /interview already writes 0.15 at birth, so this enforces existing practice rather than inventing a demand.

completed_at.description: True ship timestamp, stamped at Deliver->Complete (v0.53.0). Times the outcome->discovery loop (/metrics-pull Step 8b + session-start CHECK 10).

progression_ruling.description: Written by /mycelium:diamond-progress on EVERY assessment, v0.92.0+. Records that a progression judgement happened and which way it went. Absent means never assessed — not passed. Enumerated rather than free text because the only prior consumer grepped decision-log prose for 'block', which any paragraph explaining the gates satisfies without a gate having fired.

progression_ruled_at.description: ISO-8601 date the progression_ruling was written. Lets a consumer tell a fresh ruling from a stale one.

progression_blockers.description: Required when progression_ruling is blocked or needs-evidence; omitted when progressed.

gate.description: Which gate or threshold did not clear.

reason.description: Why, in the assessing agent's own words.

unblocked_by.description: The skill or evidence that would clear it.

completed_diamond.description: A diamond in completed_diamonds. Everything a diamond has, PLUS proof that the Definition of Done was met. The extra requirements are the point: 'completed' asserted without a verdict is the state this schema exists to make impossible, because an unevidenced completion is indistinguishable from work that merely stopped (v0.230.0).

completed_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD the DoD was judged met.

dod_verdict.description: How the pinned DoD was judged met. Written by /diamond-progress Step 9b.

signal_observed.description: What was actually OBSERVED, in the observer's words — not a restatement of the DoD's signal. If you can only restate the target, the signal was not observed.

verified_by.description: How it was checked: a metric snapshot, a named person, a test, a link. 'self-assessed' is permitted and is a real answer; an empty one is not.

threshold_met.description: The DoD threshold's actual value at completion, where the DoD declared one.

shortfall.description: Where the outcome fell short of the DoD but the diamond was completed anyway. Recording it keeps 'completed' honest instead of forcing a binary that invites rounding up.

definition_of_done.description: Outcome-based done-criterion pinned at diamond birth (v0.43.0, /define-done). outcome + signal required; the rest optional per skills/define-done/SKILL.md.

outcome.description: What changes, for WHOM — a behaviour, not a feature. Problem-first.

signal.description: The ONE observable thing you'd see them DO (OMTM).

measure.description: Optional (v0.53.0). Makes `signal` checkable post-ship to close the outcome->discovery loop (/metrics-pull Step 8b). source: 'manual' is first-class. See skills/define-done/SKILL.md.

field.description: Snapshot field path for automated sources; omit for source: manual.

check_after.description: When to check — lag matched to `kind`. Per-DoD, not a global window.

guardrail.description: Counter-metric that must not worsen while `signal` improves (Goodhart guard).

rolls_up_to.description: Parent diamond id + which parent outcome this serves (contribution-not-summation). Child diamonds only.

on_expiry.description: What happens when `date` passes and neither the outcome nor the kill has fired. The default is stop, or re-pitch with a new written date; 'continues' is not an answer (v0.227.0).

reader_test.description: Step 5 of /mycelium:define-done (v0.227.0): someone who did not write the bar resolved invented result sets with it. `resolved` short of `cases` means a word in the bar failed.

log.description: Dated record of how this Definition of Done has been scored, re-specified or ruled on. Updates go HERE, never as new dated keys beside or inside the bar (outcome, signal, threshold, kill_criterion). The bar is what the owner steers by and has to stay short enough to state from memory; the log is allowed to grow. check_dod_shape.py reports the two sizes.

moved_from.description: Retrofit only: the dated key this entry used to be.
